lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the visible lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the circular high-intensity blobs, forming a discernible grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal remoras (Echeneidae) clustered around the pectoral fin and ventral-lateral junction.
